  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "19dff498",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "(Cookbook_Simulation_Workflow)=\n",
    "# Working with OpenMM\n",
    "\n",
    "*Setting up, parametrizing, simulating, and streaming molecular dynamics trajectories from MolSysMT to OpenMM.*\n",
    "\n",
    "MolSysMT seamlessly integrates with OpenMM, allowing computational biophysicists to move effortlessly from raw experimental coordinates to energy minimization, equilibration, and production MD simulations.\n",
    "\n",
    "In this recipe, we prepare the Villin Headpiece miniprotein, add missing caps and hydrogens, solvate it, construct an OpenMM Simulation context using direct MolSysMT conversion gateways, attach native reporters, execute a simulation run, and analyze the trajectory.\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{versionadded} 1.0.0\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "abef5dae",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## System Preparation\n",
    "\n",
    "We start by loading the Villin Headpiece structure, capping terminals, adding hydrogens, and solvating in a cubic box with 0.10 M NaCl:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "3f6a17c6",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:35:56.594896Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:35:56.594551Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:36:09.346444Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:36:09.345030Z"
    }
   },

       "      <th id=\"T_dda73_level0_col2\" class=\"col_heading level0 col2\" >n_groups</th>\n",

       "      <td id=\"T_dda73_row0_col3\" class=\"data row0 col3\" >2211</td>\n",
       "      <td id=\"T_dda73_row0_col4\" class=\"data row0 col4\" >2</td>\n",
       "      <td id=\"T_dda73_row0_col5\" class=\"data row0 col5\" >2211</td>\n",
       "      <td id=\"T_dda73_row0_col6\" class=\"data row0 col6\" >3</td>\n",
       "      <td id=\"T_dda73_row0_col7\" class=\"data row0 col7\" >2208</td>\n",
       "      <td id=\"T_dda73_row0_col8\" class=\"data row0 col8\" >2</td>\n",
       "      <td id=\"T_dda73_row0_col9\" class=\"data row0 col9\" >1</td>\n",

      ],
      "text/plain": [

     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import molsysmt as msm\n",
    "\n",
    "# Load Villin Headpiece from bundled systems\n",
    "molsys = msm.convert(msm.systems['chicken villin HP35']['chicken_villin_HP35.h5msm'], to_form='molsysmt.MolSys')\n",
    "molsys = msm.build.add_missing_terminal_cappings(molsys)\n",
    "molsys = msm.build.add_missing_hydrogens(molsys)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Solvate with AMBER14 and TIP3P in a cubic box with 1.0 nm clearance\n",
    "solvated_molsys = msm.build.solvate(\n",
    "    [molsys, {'forcefield': 'AMBER14', 'water_model': 'TIP3P'}],\n",
    "    box_shape='cubic',\n",
    "    clearance='10.0 angstroms',\n",
    "    to_form='molsysmt.MolSys',\n",
    "    engine='OpenMM'\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "msm.info(solvated_molsys)"
   ]
  },
  {

   "id": "d8330d8d",

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "1a03332e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Creating OpenMM Objects\n",
    "\n",
    "We convert our prepared system directly into OpenMM native objects (`openmm.Topology` and `openmm.System`) via MolSysMT converters:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "872b3095",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:36:10.213772Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:36:10.213497Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:36:10.755103Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:36:10.753721Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "OpenMM System created with 7231 particles.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "from openmm import app, unit, LangevinIntegrator, Platform\n",
    "from molsysmt import pyunitwizard as puw\n",
    "\n",
    "# Direct conversion to openmm.Topology and openmm.System\n",
    "openmm_topology = msm.convert(solvated_molsys, to_form='openmm.Topology')\n",
    "system = msm.convert(\n",
    "    solvated_molsys,\n",
    "    to_form='openmm.System',\n",
    "    forcefield='AMBER14',\n",
    "    water_model='TIP3P',\n",
    "    non_bonded_method='PME',\n",
    "    constraints='hbonds'\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Extract and convert coordinate units\n",
    "coordinates = msm.get(solvated_molsys, coordinates=True)\n",
    "positions = puw.convert(coordinates[0], to_form='openmm.unit')\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"OpenMM System created with {system.getNumParticles()} particles.\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "140a9545",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Configuring Simulation\n",
    "\n",
    "We configure Langevin dynamics at 300 K, attach native MolSysMT reporters, and minimize potential energy:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "5a0d32db",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:36:10.758511Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:36:10.758083Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:36:14.531754Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:36:14.530736Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Integrator: Langevin dynamics at 300 K\n",
    "integrator = LangevinIntegrator(300*unit.kelvin, 1.0/unit.picosecond, 2.0*unit.femtoseconds)\n",
    "platform = Platform.getPlatformByName('CPU')\n",
    "simulation = app.Simulation(openmm_topology, system, integrator, platform)\n",
    "simulation.context.setPositions(positions)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Energy minimization\n",
    "simulation.minimizeEnergy(maxIterations=20)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Attach MolSysMT StructuresDict reporter with periodic box tracking\n",
    "from molsysmt.third_party.openmm.reporters import StructuresDictReporter\n",
    "\n",
    "structures_reporter = StructuresDictReporter(10, box=True)\n",
    "simulation.reporters.append(structures_reporter)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "b5ff7a44",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Running Simulation\n",
    "\n",
    "We execute the simulation steps and extract the collected frames into memory:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "04cca7da",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:36:14.534242Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:36:14.533993Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:36:16.071229Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:36:16.069843Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Captured 6 frames in memory.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Execute MD steps\n",
    "simulation.step(50)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Finalize reporter and construct MolSys trajectory\n",
    "traj_dict = structures_reporter.finalize()\n",
    "traj_molsys = msm.convert([solvated_molsys.topology, traj_dict], to_form='molsysmt.MolSys')\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Captured {msm.get(traj_molsys, n_structures=True)} frames in memory.\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "6eb19188",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Trajectory Analysis\n",
    "\n",
    "We calculate the C-alpha backbone RMSD progression across the simulation frames:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "id": "9044585c",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:36:16.074896Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:36:16.074503Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:36:16.609876Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:36:16.608548Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Backbone RMSD progression (nm): ['0.0000', '0.0011', '0.0024', '0.0037', '0.0050', '0.0065']\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Compute RMSD over the generated trajectory\n",
    "rmsd_values = msm.structure.get_rmsd(\n",
    "    traj_molsys,\n",
    "    selection='atom_name==\"CA\"',\n",
    "    reference_structure_index=0\n",
    ")\n",
    "rmsd_nm = [msm.pyunitwizard.get_value(val, to_unit='nm') for val in rmsd_values]\n",
    "print(\"Backbone RMSD progression (nm):\", [f\"{v:.4f}\" for v in rmsd_nm])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "b5ea39c6",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plotting RMSD Profile\n",
    "\n",
    "We plot the RMSD progression over the collected frames:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "id": "5c97abc1",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:36:16.613790Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:36:16.613403Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:36:17.038160Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:36:17.036874Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 600x350 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3.5))\n",
    "frame_indices = range(len(rmsd_nm))\n",
    "ax.plot(frame_indices, rmsd_nm, marker='o', color='#2980B9', linewidth=2)\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel('Recorded Frame')\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel('Backbone RMSD (nm)')\n",
    "ax.set_title('OpenMM Trajectory Stability')\n",
    "ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
